US Clears $320 Million Arms Package for Egypt

The United States has cleared a $320 million military aid package for Egypt. This decision comes after Egypt's support during the Iran conflict. Senator Marco Rubio waived human rights restrictions that would have otherwise blocked the release of these funds.
